rows.title_full:
AN ACT STRENGTHENING THE TECHNICAL, VOCATIONAL AND LIVELIHOOD
CURRICULUM FOR THE SENIOR HIGH SCHOOL AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS
THEREFOR
rows.title_short: T V L Curriculum Act
rows.abstract:
Aims to give senior high school diplomas and pertinent national certificates to the graduates of the Technical, Vocational and Livelihood (TVL) Curriculum for acquiring the competencies and skills necessary for employment so that various industries shall have confidence in securing their employment and provide equitable compensation.
Provides for the roles of different government agencies such as DepEd, TESDA, DOLE, DTI, and other government agencies to achieve the objectives of this Act.
Mandates the PCCI and ECOP to notify the TVL Council of the skills and expertise needed by their members and to encourage their respective members to participate in the Work Immersion as Partner Institutions who are able and willing to lend expertise and resources to the learners.
rows.status: Measure recommitted on 2023-03-21

rows.author: F057;J079;
rows.title_full:
AN ACT PROVIDING FOR A REINVESTMENT FRAMEWORK FOR REAL ESTATE
INVESTMENT TRUST (REIT) SPONSORS OR PROMOTERS, AMENDING FOR THE
PURPOSE SECTIONS 3, 8, AND 9 OF REPUBLIC ACT NO. 9856, OTHERWISE KNOWN
AS “THE REAL ESTATE INVESTMENT TRUST (REIT) ACT OF 2009”
rows.title_short:
Providing For A Reinvestment Framework For Real Estate Investment Trust ( R E I T ) Sponsors Or Promoters, Amending For The Purpose Sections 3, 8, And 9 Of Republic Act No. 9856, Otherwise Known
As “ The Real Estate Investment Trust ( R E I T ) Act Of 2009”
rows.abstract:
Requires that any proceeds realized by the sponsor or promoter from the sale of REIT shares or other securities issued in exchange for income-generating real estate transferred to REIT and any money raised by the sponsor or promoter from the sale of any of its income-generating real estate to the REIT, in any real estate, including any redevelopment thereof, or infrastructure projects in the Philippines, must be reinvested in the Philippines within one (1) year from the date of receipt of proceeds or money by the sponsor or promoter.
Mandates the REIT to submit a reinvestment plan to the Exchange and the Commission upon registration and to annually secure a certification from the Commission that it is compliant with its reinvestment plan.
rows.status: Approved by the House on 2023-03-21, transmitted to the Senate on 2023-03-22 and received by the Senate on 2023-03-22

AN ACT GRANTING ADDITIONAL BENEFITS TO FILIPINO CENTENARIANS,
RECOGNIZING OCTOGENARIANS AND NONAGENARIANS, AND
APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR, AMENDING FOR THE
PURPOSE REPUBLIC ACT NO. 10868, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE
“CENTENARIANS ACT OF 2016”
rows.title_short: Granting Additional Benefits To Filipino Centenarians, Recognizing Octogenarians And Nonagenarians, And Appropriating Funds Therefor, Amending For The Purpose Republic Act No. 10868, Otherwise Known As The “ Centenarians Act Of 2016”
rows.abstract:
Grants Filipino centenarians who reach the age of one hundred and one (101) years old a cash gift in the amount of One Million Pesos (P1,000,000.00) on their birthday.
Provides all Filipinos who reach the age of eighty (80), eighty-five (85), ninety (90) and ninety-five (95) shall receive a letter of felicitation from the President and a cash gift of Twenty-Five Thousand Pesos (25,000.00) each.
Provides that the amount for the implementation of this Act shall be included in the Annual General Appropriations Act.
rows.status: Republic Act RA11982 enacted on 2024-02-26

rows.abstract:
Seeks to amend provisions of the law/s that deny women equal decision-making power concerning family and property matters that perpetuates gender inequalities and limit women's autonomy.
Intends to address issues regarding the decision to grant or withhold consent to the marriage of children, administration and enjoyment of community property or conjugal partnership, and parental authority over the person and legal guardianship over the property of common children.

rows.title_full: AN ACT REPEALING ARTICLE 247 OF THE REVISED PENAL CODE
rows.abstract:
Seeks to repeal Art. 247 which states that  "a defense can be invoked by an accused if the killing or infliction of injuries were done out of a justified burst of passion."

Intends to address issues - that honor-based violence is gender-based- violence because victims are predominantly women, and the third paragraph pertains only to daughters and not sons - which reveals discriminatory gender-based presumptions.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on REVISION OF LAWS since 2023-03-15

rows.title_full:
AN ACT CREATING THE OFFICE OF COMMUTER AFFAIRS, DEFINING ITS POWERS
AND FUNCTIONS, AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.abstract:
Seeks to establish the Office of the Commuter Affairs that shall oversee the welfare of the riding public, address their concerns, and extend the necessary assistance.  
Provides for the powers and functions of the said Office as follows:  Assist the riding public and monitor providers to ascertain that there are safety precautions and measures installed; Coordinate with government agencies responsible for and dealing will all kinds of road, rail, air, and maritime transportation; Inspect road stations, rail stations, seaports, and airports; Monitor transport facilities to ensure that they provide appropriate access to all persons with disability; Performs accident reconstruction of road crashes and train accidents; Assist in the investigation of aviation and maritime accidents; and Establish a command center communication facility to disseminate helpful information regarding traffic situations, public safety and the like.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on TRANSPORTATION since 2023-03-20

rows.author: J097;
rows.title_full:
AN ACT INSTITUTIONALIZING THE POSITION OF ECONOMIC AND INVESTMENT
PROMOTION OFFICER IN LOCAL GOVERNMENT UNITS, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE REPUBLIC ACT NO. 7160, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE “LOCAL GOVERNMENT CODE OF 1991”
rows.abstract:
Provides for the qualifications of the municipal, city, and provincial economic and investment promotion officer such as a college degree holder preferably in Economics, Business Administration/Management, and must have acquired experience in economics or investment policy making or management or related field.
Tasks the promotion officer to take charge of the following:  
Local investment and incentives code; Local economic and investment promotion policies, projects, and activities; Promotion and marketing of the LGU as an investment location; Business potentials of the LGU to prospective investors; Generation of investments and other matters relative to economic development; Local economics database, etc.

rows.title_full:
AN ACT STRENGTHENING THE POWERS AND FUNCTIONS OF THE INTELLECTUAL
PROPERTY OFFICE OF THE PHILIPPINES, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE
REPUBLIC ACT NO. 8293, AS AMENDED, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE
“INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY CODE OF THE PHILIPPINES”
rows.title_short:
Strengthening The Powers And Functions Of The Intellectual Property Office Of The Philippines, Amending For The Purpose Republic Act No. 8293, As Amended, Otherwise Known As The
“ Intellectual Property Code Of The Philippines”
rows.abstract:
Intends to keep updated to technological advances, and adopt some of the current best practices in the international community, and fortify government efforts against piracy and counterfeiting.

Defines “counterfeit goods” which deals with violating the rights of the owner of trademark validly registered with the Intellectual Property Office of the Phils. (IPOPHL) or already declared as a well-known mark by a competent authority; and “pirated goods” . . . which are produced, reproduced, disseminated, imported, removed, altered, substituted, . . . made available to the public, or protected material broadcasted or replicated without the consent of the right holder or person duly authorized by the right holder and which are produced, or replicated from an article where making of that copy would have constituted an infringement of copyright or related rights.
rows.status: Approved by the House on 2023-05-22, transmitted to the Senate on 2023-05-24 and received by the Senate on 2023-05-24
